name: cte2-pob
description: Path of Building for Craft to Exile 2

scripts.audit: npm run build && node tools/audit-port-coverage.mjs --src "/g/Projects/Mine-And-Slash-Rework-1.20-Forge" --snapshot data/snapshot.json
scripts.build: npm run -w @cte2/extractor build && npm run -w @cte2/schema build && npm run -w @cte2/engine build
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run -w @cte2/app dev
scripts.build:app: npm run build && npm run -w @cte2/app build
scripts.dist:app: npm run build:app && npm run -w @cte2/app dist
scripts.preview:site: npm run build:site && npx --yes serve packages/app/out/web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run -ws --if-present test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run -ws --if-present typecheck
